programmes.d: The Durango Kid learns that crooked scouts are behind attempts to escalate a war between a local tribe and the cavalry.
Settlers and a sheriff catch on to a Chicago swindler's land scam.
An Arizona land-grabber (Telly Savalas) and his brother (George Maharis) renew their feud amid Army troops and Apaches.
Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.
A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.
A new lawman (Bill Elliott) punches out cattle rustlers who like to shoot sheriffs.
A Chicago hotel desk clerk (Jack Lemmon) talks a trail boss (Glenn Ford) into taking him on a cattle drive to Mexico.
A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) turns cowhand and then back again, fighting a cattle baron with two daughters (Barbara Britton, Dorothy Hart).
A wildcatter (Faye Dunaway), her father (John Mills) and a boozing drifter (George C. Scott) defend her oil derrick in 1913 Oklahoma.
A quiet cowboy (Buck Jones) on a white horse saves a gal (Dorothy Fay) from cattle rustlers.
A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.
A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.
The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).
An Arizona rancher (Randolph Scott) protects his empire from a rival landowner (Richard Boone) and his hired guns.
The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) bags Mexican-border silver smugglers for Uncle Sam.
